scope: Static source review; not deployed/runtime coverage certification

master: Master/configuration/security or mapping only; no dated transaction, stock quantity or journal mutation. Referenced master changes affect future documents; do not guard these as historical postings.
read: Read/validation/export or job-file preparation only. E-invoice JSON writes an export file, upload returns 501; neither changes ERP financial documents.
control: Period configuration/reopen/blocked-close control and audit, not a source financial document. Own authenticated ACCOUNTING grants and active transaction retained.
service: APPROVED HERE only: SALES/SALES_SERVICE add/edit/delete + requestTenant. voucherDate requested and persisted original on edit/delete. Baseline has no transaction. Party/firm/service reads, number floor/increment, create/save/soft-delete must share active session; guard before counter or document mutation. Desktop supplied numbering remains unchanged.
journal: TRANSACTIONS/JOURNAL_VOUCHER; tenant(req.auth). withTransaction already includes number/document/journal/audit. Dates: stored and proposed vDate, selected original journal documentDate, actual reversal argument (edit proposed-or-stored; delete stored). Guard before number/reversal/save; preserve idempotent existing-result path.
purchase: VOUCHERS/PURCHASE; tenant source shown in evidence (some body-derived; compare against req.auth before guard). Existing transaction covers number/header/stock/journal/audit. Dates: invoiceDate original/proposed, selected journal dates and actual reversal date (businessDateIST for cancellation). Repair uses persisted invoiceDate, reactivation stock movements and missing-journal creation; guard before first mutation. No new date rule needed for own posting dates.
salesedit: SALES/SALES_BILLING; existing active transaction. req.auth plus tenant-scoped source reads. BillDate stored/proposed, selected journal and actual reversal dates; cancellation uses businessDateIST. Preflight before stock reversal/header/load snapshot/journal/movement/audit. Include zero-value skip-posting path and both cancellation entry points.
salescreate: UNAPPROVED: active document transaction but nextDocumentNumber deliberately reserves independently (server.js:12633-12645 omits session). Move number reservation into same transaction requires separate approval. BillDate; party/company/godown/tax/rate/credit/stock and idempotent commit reconciliation must remain intact.
billtype: UNAPPROVED: body tenant, global authentication but no route grant. SalesHeader and embedded LoadHeader bill-type updates have no transaction. Persisted BillDate and affected load dates must be resolved; no authorization correction authorized here.
allocation: TRANSACTIONS PAYMENT/RECEIPT and authenticated tenant. Primary create/edit/delete have withTransaction but mutate purchase/sales/opening allocated counters before journal. Own old/new vDate or receiptDate and selected original/reversal journal dates are available. Business decision needed on whether linked source invoice/opening posting periods must also be OPEN; do not substitute receipt bill reference date for postingDate. releaseOpening has no tenant in signature. Existing early idempotent/no-op behavior retained.
legacyreceipt: UNAPPROVED nontransactional legacy receipt writer: preserve posted-receipt immutability rejection; non-POSTED edit still mutates. Date receiptDate stored/proposed; tenantFilter on lookup/update but update payload tenant fields require review. Duplicate POST at transaction.js:1270 is shadowed by first handler (no next), still inventoried as dormant code.
serverreceipt: Legacy /api/receipt has active transaction and number+Receipt create but no balanced journal call. receiptDate defaults from existing behavior; linked bill BillDate. Decide reference-period policy and relationship to primary receipt workflow before integration. Do not add posting as incidental guard work.
cheque: UNAPPROVED: TRANSACTIONS route-specific add/edit/delete, no transaction around counter/document/status mutation. chqBounceDate / pdcDate or docDate / transactionDate / collectionDate respectively, stored and proposed. Create cheque-bounce trusts body tenant; other creates force auth tenant; edits initially load tenantFilter but may copy body tenant into update. Delete status REVERSED with no invented cancellation posting/date. No common journal call in these families.
stock: VOUCHERS/STOCK_ADJUSTMENT; existing transaction and authenticated tenant. Create VoucherDate defaults UTC today; edit/delete movementDate is businessDateIST, while original/replacement VoucherDate may differ. Require explicit effective-date treatment of these existing movements before integration; do not change dates/valuation. moveStockForAdjustment, Stock/DamStock, request-id/status locks, movements and audit are one dependency set.
batch: TOOLS/BATCH_LOCK and BATCH_RATE_OVERRIDE conditional edit grants; auth tenant. Stock/product reads before transaction; stock SRate/IsLocked + audit bulk writes inside it. No authoritative financial effective date; decide whether rate/lock is a period-controlled event. If included, same-session source-read boundary change also needs approval.
opening: MASTER/ACCOUNT, authenticated tenant on main account routes. saveAccountWithOpenings legacy path save(null); transactional path saves account before deriving old/new opening postingDate. Direct opening/journal supersession, allocations and account summary/history semantics require business decision AND separate transaction approval for legacy branch. Do not turn reference row.date into postingDate or rewrite historical events. Delete master can affect legacy opening visibility; no opening reversal is implemented.
otheropening: MASTER/OTHER_ACCOUNT; openingBal can be created/edited and account soft-deleted with no authoritative opening posting date/transaction. Requires effective-date and opening-summary policy, then separate same-session architecture approval. No journal posting added.
import: importPermission + req.security tenant; Account import carries openingBal without openingDate/billwise events (importConfig.js). Active transaction includes ImportBatch + master inserts; Product upsert and postcommit GST sync are master-only. Decide legacy opening effective-date semantics for Account rows; do not fabricate dates.
dispatch: TOOLS desktop-import grant, owned job tenant + forwarded Authorization. runDesktopImport dispatches mapped sales/purchase/notes/receipt/service/stock/cheque/etc to target HTTP writers, repair targets purchase reconciliation; independent per-record commits, not one Mongo transaction. Retry/resume may continue writes; pause does not undo in-flight writes. Inherits each target blocker/date policy. Direct supplier/bank master inserts have no transaction; rollback deletes captured master IDs without tenant predicate and calls transaction DELETE endpoints. Require scope/compensation decisions; no global batch transaction authorized.
load: Load snapshots mutate sales/load financial-document metadata and totals; conservatively included, even without journal. CREATE_LOAD/SETTLE_LOAD grants where present; load-transfer lacks route-specific grant. LoadDate / loadDate, embedded BillDate and receiptDate are not one authoritative posting date. Create/edit/transfer/load-delete have transaction; GET load-bills repairs snapshots without one; legacy settle create/edit/delete lack transaction. settle-load/save additionally upserts/reverses Receipt and sales statuses inside existing transaction. Requires business decision for snapshot/settlement and generated receipt effective dates; any missing boundary separately approved.
quotation: Quotation document/number only; inspected create/edit/delete do not mutate stock, journals, sales allocations or posted invoices. Prospective quote, outside financial-period enforcement; counter is QUOTATION only.
debit: VOUCHERS/DEBIT_NOTE, authenticated tenant (cancellation body scope must match req.auth). Existing transaction includes tenant references, original purchase limits, stock helper, number/note/journal/audit. Dates old/new VDate, original/latest journal date and actual reversal argument; delete uses businessDateIST. Guard before stock and numbering. Reference purchase is validated but no allocation counter mutation; preserve return limits.
allocationNote: VOUCHERS/CREDIT_NOTE, existing transaction. Old/new VDate, original/latest journal and actual reversal date (delete businessDateIST) available. In addition stock helper and adjustSalesBillForCreditNote / direct SalesHeader updates change referenced sales return/credit metadata. Resolve linked source-period policy before implementation; no tax, valuation or reversal-date redesign authorized.
